title: Jim Furyk Equalls All-Time Scoring Record to Win Maiden Major at Olympia Fields
description: Jim Furyk posts an 8-under total of 272 to win the 103rd US Open by three strokes over Stephen Leaney.

title: Retief Goosen Displays Masterclass Putting on Baked Shinnecock Greens to Win Second US Open
description: Retief Goosen takes only 24 putts on lightning-fast greens on Sunday to edge Phil Mickelson by two strokes at Shinnecock Hills.

title: Michael Campbell Stuns Field as Sectional Qualifier to Win Pinehurst US Open
description: New Zealand's Michael Campbell shoots a final-round 69 to hold off Tiger Woods by two strokes and capture the 105th US Open.

title: Geoff Ogilvy Survives Wild Final Hole Double-Bogeys by Rivals to Win Winged Foot US Open
description: Geoff Ogilvy chips in on 17 and saves par on 18 while Phil Mickelson and Colin Montgomerie double-bogey the final hole.

title: Angel Cabrera Battles Oakmont Brutality to Edge Woods and Furyk for US Open Crown
description: Angel Cabrera shoots 69 on Sunday to post 5-over 285, edging Tiger Woods and Jim Furyk by one shot to become Argentina's first US Open champion.

title: Tiger Woods Sinks Twelve-Foot Birdie on Seventy-Second Hole on Broken Leg at Torrey Pines
description: Playing with a double stress fracture and torn ACL, Tiger Woods sinks a dramatic birdie putt on 18 to force a Monday playoff against Rocco Mediate.

title: Lucas Glover Weathers Relentless Rain Delays to Win US Open at Bethpage Black
description: Lucas Glover shoots 4-under 276 across five grueling weather-delayed days to win by two strokes over Phil Mickelson and David Duval.

title: President Pratibha Patil Confers Padma Bhushan on Music Composer A.R. Rahman in New Delhi
description: Oscar-winning composer A.R. Rahman received the Padma Bhushan at the Civil Investiture Ceremony.

title: Graeme McDowell Ends Forty-Year European Drought with Pebble Beach US Open Triumph
description: Northern Ireland's Graeme McDowell stays steady on baked Pebble Beach greens to become the first European US Open champion since 1970.

title: Rory McIlroy Demolishes US Open Scoring Records with Sixteen-Under Masterclass at Congressional
description: Twenty-two-year-old Rory McIlroy shatters scoring records, posting 16-under 268 to win by eight strokes and claim his first major title.

title: Webb Simpson Rallies from Four Strokes Back to Win Olympic Club US Open
description: Webb Simpson cards four birdies in five holes around the turn to shoot 68 and edge Graeme McDowell and Michael Thompson by one shot.

title: Justin Rose Hits Pure Four-Iron on Final Hole to Win Emotional US Open at Merion
description: Justin Rose looks to the heavens on Father's Day after hitting a stellar approach to the 18th hole to become England's first US Open winner in 43 years.

title: Martin Kaymer Dominates Pinehurst No. 2 Wire-to-Wire for Eight-Shot US Open Victory
description: Germany's Martin Kaymer posts rounds of 65-65-72-69 to finish 9-under 271, winning the 114th US Open by eight strokes.

title: President Pranab Mukherjee Confers Padma Bhushan on Tennis Champion Sania Mirza
description: Former world number one doubles tennis player Sania Mirza was conferred the Padma Bhushan at Rashtrapati Bhavan.

title: President Droupadi Murmu Confers Padma Bhushan on Philanthropist Sudha Murty
description: Author, educator, and philanthropist Sudha Murty was presented the Padma Bhushan at Rashtrapati Bhavan.

title: Nirad C. Chaudhuri Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for Max Muller Biography
description: Scholar Nirad C. Chaudhuri was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award for Scholar Extraordinary.

title: Jack Nicklaus Captures Fourth PGA Championship Victory at Firestone Country Club
description: Jack Nicklaus posts a four-round total of 276 at Firestone to defeat Bruce Crampton by two strokes for his 14th major title.

title: Historian Sarvepalli Gopal Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for Nehru Biography
description: Sarvepalli Gopal received the Sahitya Akademi Award for his monumental biography Jawaharlal Nehru.

title: Dave Stockton Sinks Fifteen-Foot Par Putt on Final Green at Congressional to Win PGA
description: Dave Stockton drains a clutch par putt on the 72nd hole to edge Raymond Floyd and Don January by one stroke at Congressional.

title: Chaman Nahal Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for Partition Novel Azadi in New Delhi
description: Chaman Nahal was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award for Azadi, chronicling the trauma of Partition.

title: Lanny Wadkins Triumphs in First Sudden-Death Major Playoff at Pebble Beach
description: Lanny Wadkins birdies the third extra hole to defeat Gene Littler in the first sudden-death playoff in major championship history.

title: Anita Desai Conferred Sahitya Akademi Award for English Novel Fire on the Mountain
description: Anita Desai received the Sahitya Akademi Award in New Delhi for her psychological novel set in Kasauli.

title: John Mahaffey Rallies from Seven Shots Back to Win PGA Playoff at Oakmont
description: John Mahaffey shoots 66 on Sunday and birdies the second playoff hole to beat Tom Watson and Jerry Pate for the 60th PGA Championship.

title: David Graham Outlasts Ben Crenshaw on Third Extra Hole at Oakland Hills
description: David Graham recovers from a double-bogey on the 72nd hole to defeat Ben Crenshaw with a birdie in sudden death at Oakland Hills.

title: Jack Nicklaus Obliterates Field by Seven Strokes to Win Fifth PGA Championship at Oak Hill
description: Jack Nicklaus is the only golfer under par, winning by seven strokes at Oak Hill to tie Walter Hagen's record of five PGA titles.

title: Poet Jayanta Mahapatra Conferred Sahitya Akademi Award for Relationship
description: Jayanta Mahapatra became the first Indian English poet to receive the Sahitya Akademi Award.

title: Larry Nelson Fires Four Rounds Under Seventy to Win Atlanta Athletic Club PGA
description: Larry Nelson shoots 273 to defeat Fuzzy Zoeller by four strokes, capturing his first major championship in his home state of Georgia.

title: Jordan Spieth Survives Dramatic Chambers Bay Finish to Win Back-to-Back Major Titles
description: Twenty-one-year-old Jordan Spieth wins the US Open when Dustin Johnson three-putts from 12 feet on the 72nd hole at Chambers Bay.

title: Dustin Johnson Overcomes Bizarre Rules Penalty on Final Round to Win Oakmont US Open
description: Dustin Johnson flushes a 6-iron to five feet on 18 to render a controversial one-stroke ball-movement penalty irrelevant and capture his maiden major.

title: Brooks Koepka Successfully Defends US Open Title on Treacherous Shinnecock Greens
description: Brooks Koepka shoots 68 on Sunday to become the first golfer to defend a US Open title since Curtis Strange in 1989.

title: Gary Woodland Hits Daring Three-Wood from Rough to Seal Pebble Beach US Open Victory
description: Gary Woodland clips a 3-wood from the rough to the 14th green and chips from the 17th putting green to hold off Brooks Koepka by three shots.

title: Bryson DeChambeau Overpowers Brutal Winged Foot with Final Round Sixty-Seven to Win US Open
description: Bryson DeChambeau shoots 67 as the only player under par in the rescheduled fall US Open, winning by six strokes at Winged Foot.

title: Jon Rahm Sinks Clutch Birdie Putts on Final Two Holes at Torrey Pines to Win First Major
description: Jon Rahm drains a 24-foot sweeping birdie putt on 17 and an 18-footer on 18 to edge Louis Oosthuizen by one stroke at Torrey Pines.

title: Matt Fitzpatrick Plays Miraculous Fairway Bunker Shot on Eighteenth to Win Brookline US Open
description: England's Matt Fitzpatrick hits a 9-iron to 18 feet from fairway sand on the 72nd hole to win the US Open at The Country Club, matching Jack Nicklaus.

title: Wyndham Clark Saves Par on Final Two Holes to Edge McIlroy at Los Angeles Country Club
description: Wyndham Clark maintains his nerve on the final green to shoot even-par 70 and win the 123rd US Open by one stroke over Rory McIlroy.

title: Jack Nicklaus Sinks Forty-Foot Birdie on Sixteenth to Win Fifth Masters Over Miller and Weiskopf
description: Jack Nicklaus drains a legendary 40-foot birdie putt across the 16th green to win the 39th Masters Tournament by one stroke.

title: Arun Joshi Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for Philosophical Novel The Last Labyrinth
description: Arun Joshi was presented the Sahitya Akademi Award in New Delhi for his existential novel.

title: Raymond Floyd Opens with Sixty-Three and Goes Wire-to-Wire at Southern Hills
description: Raymond Floyd maintains control throughout the week to win his second PGA Championship by three shots over Lanny Wadkins.

title: Nissim Ezekiel Conferred Sahitya Akademi Award for Latter-Day Psalms
description: Modernist poet Nissim Ezekiel received the Sahitya Akademi Award for his poetry collection Latter-Day Psalms.

title: Hal Sutton Withstands Jack Nicklaus Charge to Win Sixty-Fifth PGA Championship at Riviera
description: Twenty-five-year-old Hal Sutton leads from start to finish, holding off a final-round 66 from Jack Nicklaus to win at Riviera.

title: Keki N. Daruwalla Conferred Sahitya Akademi Award for The Keeper of the Dead
description: Parsi-Indian poet Keki Daruwalla was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award for his poetry collection.

title: Lee Trevino Shoots Fifteen-Under at Age Forty-Four to Win Shoal Creek PGA
description: Lee Trevino becomes the first player in PGA Championship history to shoot all four rounds under 70, finishing 15-under 273.

title: Kamala Das Conferred Sahitya Akademi Award for English Collected Poems
description: Bilingual poetess Kamala Das received the Sahitya Akademi Award in New Delhi for her frank lyrical poetry.

title: Hubert Green Fends Off Lee Trevino Sunday Comeback at Cherry Hills
description: Hubert Green shoots 278 to hold off defending champion Lee Trevino by two strokes to win the 67th PGA Championship in Denver.

title: Nayantara Sahgal Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for English Novel Rich Like Us
description: Nayantara Sahgal received the Sahitya Akademi Award for Rich Like Us, examining life during the Emergency.

title: Bob Tway Holes Legendary Bunker Shot on Final Hole at Inverness to Stun Greg Norman
description: Bob Tway holes out from greenside sand on the 72nd hole at Inverness Club to snatch the PGA Championship away from Greg Norman.

title: Larry Nelson Edges Lanny Wadkins on First Playoff Hole at PGA National
description: Larry Nelson makes par on the first sudden-death hole in oppressive Florida heat to capture his second PGA Championship.

title: Jeff Sluman Shoots Sunday Sixty-Five with Hole-Out Eagle to Win Oak Tree PGA
description: Jeff Sluman chips in for eagle on the fifth hole and fires a 65 to win the 70th PGA Championship by three strokes over Paul Azinger.

title: Payne Stewart Surges from Six Shots Behind with Final Round Sixty-Five at Kemper Lakes
description: Payne Stewart birdies four of the last five holes to surpass Mike Reid and win the 71st PGA Championship by one stroke.

title: Wayne Grady Captures First Major Title with Steady Final Round at Shoal Creek
description: Australia's Wayne Grady cards a 1-under 71 to win the 72nd PGA Championship by three shots over Fred Couples.

title: Nick Price Breaks Through for Maiden Major Victory at Bellerive Country Club
description: Zimbabwe's Nick Price birdies the final two holes on Saturday and closes with 70 to win the 74th PGA Championship by three shots.

title: Nick Price Decimates Field with Six-Stroke Victory at Southern Hills
description: Nick Price wins back-to-back majors following his Open victory, shooting 11-under 269 to cruise to a six-stroke win at Southern Hills.

title: Mark Brooks Birdies Eighteenth Twice to Win Sudden-Death Playoff at Valhalla
description: Mark Brooks birdies the 72nd hole to force a playoff with Kenny Perry, then birdies the same hole again in sudden death to win.

title: Davis Love III Wins Winged Foot PGA Championship Under Dramatic Rainbow
description: Davis Love III shoots 66 in the final round to win by five strokes at Winged Foot as a rainbow arches over the 18th fairway.

title: Vijay Singh Holds Off Field in Dense Sahalee Pines to Claim Maiden Major
description: Fiji's Vijay Singh shoots 9-under 271 through the narrow, tree-lined fairways of Sahalee Country Club to win the 80th PGA Championship.

title: Raymond Floyd Ties Masters Scoring Record at Seventeen-Under to Capture Green Jacket
description: Raymond Floyd leads wire-to-wire, equaling Jack Nicklaus's record 271 total to win the 1976 Masters by eight strokes.

title: Tom Watson Birdies Seventeenth Hole to Edge Jack Nicklaus for Maiden Masters Crown
description: Tom Watson sinks a 20-foot birdie on the 17th hole at Augusta National to defeat Jack Nicklaus by two strokes.

title: Gary Player Shoots Final Round Sixty-Four to Stun Field at 1978 Masters Tournament
description: Forty-two-year-old Gary Player birdies seven of his last ten holes to rally from seven shots behind and capture his third Green Jacket.

title: Fuzzy Zoeller Birdies Eleventh in Sudden Death to Win Masters on Debut Appearance
description: Fuzzy Zoeller becomes the first golfer since 1935 to win the Masters in his first appearance, defeating Ed Sneed and Tom Watson in a playoff.

title: Seve Ballesteros Romps to Victory at Augusta to Become Youngest Masters Champion
description: Twenty-three-year-old Seve Ballesteros opens up a ten-stroke lead on Sunday and wins by four to become the first European Masters champion.

title: Tom Watson Holds Off Surging Jack Nicklaus to Win Second Green Jacket
description: Tom Watson posts an 8-under 280 to edge Jack Nicklaus and Johnny Miller by two strokes for his second Masters victory.

title: Craig Stadler Defeats Dan Pohl on First Playoff Hole to Win Forty-Sixth Masters
description: Craig Stadler makes par on the tenth hole to overcome Dan Pohl in sudden death after squandering a six-shot back-nine lead in regulation.

title: Seve Ballesteros Starts Birdie-Eagle on Monday Finish to Cruise to Second Masters Title
description: Seve Ballesteros goes 4-under through four holes on Monday following weekend rain delays to win the 1983 Masters by four shots.

title: Ben Crenshaw Sinks Sixty-Foot Birdie on Tenth to Secure Emotional Maiden Masters Win
description: Gentle Ben Crenshaw shoots a final-round 68 to capture his first major championship by two strokes over Tom Watson.

title: Bernhard Langer Rallies Past Curtis Strange on Back Nine to Become First German Masters Champion
description: Bernhard Langer birdies four of the last seven holes to overcome a four-stroke deficit and claim the 49th Masters Tournament.

title: Larry Mize Miracle Chip-In on Eleventh Green Stuns Greg Norman in Sudden Death
description: Augusta native Larry Mize chips in from 140 feet off the green on the second playoff hole to shock Greg Norman and win the Masters.

title: Sandy Lyle Plays Famous Bunker Approach on Eighteenth to Win Fiftieth Masters
description: Sandy Lyle hits a 7-iron from the fairway bunker on the 72nd hole to ten feet and sinks the birdie putt to win the Green Jacket.

title: Nick Faldo Sinks Twenty-Five-Foot Birdie in Twilight to Win First Green Jacket
description: Nick Faldo shoots 65 in the final round and birdies the second sudden-death playoff hole in near-darkness to defeat Scott Hoch.

title: Shashi Deshpande Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for English Novel That Long Silence
description: Feminist novelist Shashi Deshpande was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award for That Long Silence.

title: I. Allan Sealy Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for Anglo-Indian Chronicle The Trotter-Nama
description: I. Allan Sealy received the Sahitya Akademi Award in New Delhi for his sprawling debut epic.

title: Ian Woosnam Sinks Eight-Foot Par Putt on Eighteenth Green to Win Fifty-Fifth Masters
description: Wales's Ian Woosnam scrambles for par on the 72nd hole to edge Jose Maria Olazabal by one stroke and claim his first major championship.

title: Jose Maria Olazabal Edges Tom Lehman on Back Nine to Claim Maiden Masters Title
description: Jose Maria Olazabal eagles the 15th hole to finish 9-under 279, holding off Tom Lehman to become Spain's second Masters champion.

title: Playwright Mahesh Dattani Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for Final Solutions
description: Mahesh Dattani became the first playwright writing in English to win the Sahitya Akademi Award.

title: Kiran Nagarkar Conferred Sahitya Akademi Award for English Historical Novel Cuckold
description: Kiran Nagarkar received the Sahitya Akademi Award for his 16th-century Mewar epic Cuckold.

title: Historian Rajmohan Gandhi Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for Rajaji A Life
description: Rajmohan Gandhi was presented the Sahitya Akademi Award for his definitive biography of C. Rajagopalachari.

title: Bernard Thevenet Drops Eddy Merckx on Pra-Loup to Seize Tour de France Yellow Jersey
description: Bernard Thevenet attacks Eddy Merckx on the climb to Pra-Loup, taking two minutes and ending Merckx's era of Tour dominance.

title: Lucien Van Impe Attacks on Col du Tourmalet to Dominate 1976 Tour de France
description: Belgian climber Lucien Van Impe launches a decisive attack on stage 14 to Saint-Lary-Soulan to seal his overall Tour de France victory.

title: Hennie Kuiper Wins Stage Seventeen Atop Alpe d'Huez Ahead of Bernard Thevenet
description: Dutch rider Hennie Kuiper tames the 21 hairpin bends of Alpe d'Huez to win stage 17 of the 1977 Tour de France.

title: Joaquim Agostinho Solos Up Alpe d'Huez to Win Tour Stage at Age Thirty-Six
description: Portuguese veteran Joaquim Agostinho rides solo up the grueling slopes of Alpe d'Huez to win stage 17 of the 1979 Tour de France.

title: Peter Winnen Triumphs on Alpe d'Huez for Historic Dutch Bastille Day Victory
description: Twenty-three-year-old Peter Winnen conquers Alpe d'Huez on France's national day, winning stage 17 for the Dutch Capri Sonne squad.

title: Beat Breu Conquers Twenty-One Hairpins to Win Alpe d'Huez Stage
description: Swiss climbing specialist Beat Breu breaks away on the lower slopes to win stage 16 atop Alpe d'Huez in the 1982 Tour de France.

title: Luis Herrera Becomes First Colombian Stage Winner in Tour de France History on Alpe d'Huez
description: Luis 'Lucho' Herrera dances up Alpe d'Huez to become the first Colombian and first amateur rider to win a stage of the Tour de France.

title: Luis Herrera Solos to Famous Mountain Victory Atop Luz Ardiden
description: Luis Herrera drops the peloton on the Pyrenean ascent of Luz Ardiden to win stage 14, cementing his King of the Mountains jersey.

title: Bernard Hinault and Greg LeMond Cross Alpe d'Huez Finish Line Hand-in-Hand
description: La Vie Claire teammates Bernard Hinault and Greg LeMond obliterate the field and cross the Alpe d'Huez finish line arm-in-arm.

title: Federico Echave Wins Twentieth Stage of Tour de France Atop Alpe d'Huez
description: Spain's Federico Echave attacks from the breakaway to claim stage 20 on Alpe d'Huez in one of the closest Tours in history.

title: Steven Rooks Powers Up Alpe d'Huez to Secure Double Victory for PDM
description: Steven Rooks wins stage 12 atop Alpe d'Huez and secures the polka-dot King of the Mountains jersey in the 1988 Tour de France.

title: Gert-Jan Theunisse Solos Over Galibier and Croix de Fer to Win on Alpe d'Huez
description: Gert-Jan Theunisse completes an audacious 130-kilometer solo mountain raid across three Alpine passes to win atop Alpe d'Huez.

title: Gianni Bugno Outsprints Greg LeMond to Claim Alpe d'Huez Stage in World Champion Jersey
description: Italian star Gianni Bugno edges Greg LeMond in a thrilling uphill sprint to win stage 11 of the 1990 Tour de France on Alpe d'Huez.

title: Mark OMeara Birdies Final Two Holes at Augusta to Win Maiden Major Championship
description: Forty-one-year-old Mark O'Meara sinks a 20-foot birdie putt on the 72nd hole to edge Fred Couples and David Duval by one stroke.

title: Jose Maria Olazabal Overcomes Crippling Arthritis to Win Second Green Jacket
description: Jose Maria Olazabal completes an inspiring career comeback, holding off Greg Norman and Davis Love III to win the 63rd Masters.

title: Amit Chaudhuri Conferred Sahitya Akademi Award for English Novel A New World
description: Novelist and musician Amit Chaudhuri received the Sahitya Akademi Award in New Delhi.

title: Upamanyu Chatterjee Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for The Mammaries of the Welfare State
description: Upamanyu Chatterjee won the Sahitya Akademi Award for his bureaucratic satire sequel to English, August.

title: Ramachandra Guha Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for Monumental History India After Gandhi
description: Historian Ramachandra Guha was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award in New Delhi for India After Gandhi.

title: Jeet Thayil Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for Poetry Collection These Errors Are Correct
description: Poet and novelist Jeet Thayil received the Sahitya Akademi Award for his grief poetry collection.

title: Temsula Ao Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for Laburnum for My Head in New Delhi
description: Naga writer Temsula Ao was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award for her short story collection.

title: Andy Hampsten Triumphs on Alpe d'Huez for Motorola in Historic American Stage Win
description: Andy Hampsten solos to victory atop Alpe d'Huez on stage 14, becoming the only American to win on the Dutch Mountain.

title: Luc Leblanc Wins Pyrenean Showdown on Hautacam Ahead of Indurain and Pantani
description: Frenchman Luc Leblanc battles dense fog to defeat Marco Pantani and Miguel Indurain atop Hautacam in stage 11 of the Tour.

title: Marco Pantani Sets All-Time Record Ascent Time Up Alpe d'Huez to Win Tenth Stage
description: Marco Pantani scales Alpe d'Huez in a blistering record time of 36 minutes 50 seconds to win stage 10 of the 1995 Tour de France.

title: Marco Pantani Dances Away from Jan Ullrich on Alpe d'Huez for Second Climbing Triumph
description: Marco Pantani attacks repeatedly on the lower hairpins of Alpe d'Huez to win stage 13 by forty-seven seconds over race leader Jan Ullrich.

title: Marco Pantani Attacks in Freezing Rain on Col du Galibier to Win at Les Deux Alpes
description: Marco Pantani breaks away in driving rain 50 kilometers from the finish, putting nearly nine minutes into Jan Ullrich to seize yellow.

title: Marco Pantani Outduels Lance Armstrong Atop Mont Ventoux on Bastille Day
description: Marco Pantani and Lance Armstrong fight side-by-side up the lunar landscape of Mont Ventoux, with Pantani crossing the line first on stage 12.

title: Frank Schleck Climbs to Landmark Alpe d'Huez Stage Victory for Team CSC
description: Luxembourg's Frank Schleck breaks clear with Damiano Cunego before dropping him on the final slopes to capture stage 15 atop Alpe d'Huez.

title: Carlos Sastre Attacks at Base of Alpe d'Huez to Take Tour Yellow Jersey
description: Spain's Carlos Sastre launches an all-or-nothing attack on the first hairpin of Alpe d'Huez, winning stage 17 by over two minutes.

title: Andy Schleck Launches Sixty-Kilometer Solo Mountain Raid Over Izoard to Win on Galibier
description: Andy Schleck attacks on the Col d'Izoard and rides solo for two hours to conquer the highest mountain finish in Tour history atop Galibier.

title: Pierre Rolland Delivers French Victory on Alpe d'Huez Ahead of Samuel Sanchez
description: Pierre Rolland wins stage 19 atop Alpe d'Huez for Europcar, ending a five-year French stage drought on the storied Alpine peak.

title: Chris Froome Powers Past Nairo Quintana on Mont Ventoux on Bastille Day
description: Chris Froome launches a high-cadence seated acceleration to drop Nairo Quintana near the summit of Mont Ventoux to win stage 15.

title: Christophe Riblon Survives Ditch Crash to Win Double Ascent of Alpe d'Huez
description: Christophe Riblon overshoots a hairpin into a ditch on the Col de Sarenne descent but recovers to catch Tejay van Garderen and win stage 18.

title: Adil Jussawalla Conferred Sahitya Akademi Award for Trying to Say Goodbye
description: Poet Adil Jussawalla was presented the Sahitya Akademi Award after a 35-year publishing hiatus.

title: Vincenzo Nibali Romps to Dominant Victory on Hautacam in Yellow Jersey
description: Tour leader Vincenzo Nibali drops all rivals on the final Pyrenean climb of Hautacam to claim his fourth stage win by over a minute.

title: Thibaut Pinot Wins Stage Twenty Atop Alpe d'Huez Before Ecstatic French Crowd
description: Thibaut Pinot holds off a rampaging Nairo Quintana to win stage 20 atop Alpe d'Huez on the penultimate day of the 2015 Tour de France.

title: Jerry Pinto Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for Debut Novel Em and the Big Hoom
description: Jerry Pinto received the Sahitya Akademi Award for his tender autobiographical novel on mental illness.

title: Mamang Dai Conferred Sahitya Akademi Award for Historical Novel The Black Hill
description: Arunachal author Mamang Dai received the Sahitya Akademi Award for her northeastern historical novel.

title: Anuradha Roy Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for All the Lives We Never Lived
description: Anuradha Roy was presented the Sahitya Akademi Award in New Delhi for her lyrical novel.

title: Geraint Thomas Becomes First British Winner on Alpe d'Huez While Wearing Yellow
description: Geraint Thomas sprints past Tom Dumoulin and Chris Froome in the final 200 meters atop Alpe d'Huez to win stage 12 in the maillot jaune.

title: Shashi Tharoor Conferred Sahitya Akademi Award for Non-Fiction An Era of Darkness
description: Shashi Tharoor received the Sahitya Akademi Award for his study of the British colonial empire in India.

title: Government of Gujarat Notifies Gir National Park to Protect Asiatic Lions
description: The sanctuary surrounding Sasan Gir was upgraded to a National Park to protect the world's last surviving Asiatic lions.

title: Government of Karnataka Notifies Bandipur National Park under Project Tiger
description: The erstwhile royal hunting grounds of the Maharaja of Mysore were notified as Bandipur National Park.

title: Pioneer Venus One Spacecraft Enters Orbit Around Venus to Map Cloud Layers
description: NASA's Pioneer Venus 1 successfully inserts into orbit around Venus to perform radar altimetry and characterize the atmosphere.

title: Pioneer Venus Multiprobe Atmospheric Probes Enter Venusian Atmosphere Across Cloud Decks
description: Four atmospheric entry probes from Pioneer Venus Multiprobe descend through the dense Venusian clouds simultaneously.

title: Government of Rajasthan Notifies Ranthambore as National Park in Sawai Madhopur
description: The royal hunting forests surrounding Ranthambore Fort were officially designated a National Park.

title: Hemis National Park Established in Ladakh as India's Largest Protected High-Altitude Reserve
description: Hemis National Park was notified in Jammu & Kashmir, becoming India's premier snow leopard sanctuary.

title: Voyager Two Makes Closest Encounter with Saturn Revealing Complex Ringlet Dynamics
description: Voyager 2 passes within 101,000 kilometers of Saturn, returning thousands of high-resolution images of rings and icy satellites.

title: Soviet Vega Two Spacecraft Flies Through Dust Coma of Comet Halley
description: Vega 2 makes its closest approach to Comet Halley at 8,030 kilometers, returning mass spectrometer data on cometary dust.

title: Galileo Spacecraft Performs Historic First Close Encounter with Asteroid Gaspra
description: NASA's Galileo probe makes humanity's first spacecraft encounter with an asteroid, imaging 951 Gaspra from 1,600 kilometers away.

title: Galileo Spacecraft Discovers First Asteroid Moon Dactyl Orbiting Asteroid Ida
description: Galileo flies past asteroid 243 Ida and discovers Dactyl, confirming for the first time that asteroids can possess natural moons.

title: Carl Lewis Leaps 8.50 Meters to Win Fourth Consecutive Olympic Long Jump Gold in Atlanta
description: Thirty-five-year-old Carl Lewis hits 8.50 meters on his third jump to match Al Oerter with four consecutive Olympic golds in the same event.

title: NEAR Shoemaker Spacecraft Flies Past Carbonaceous Asteroid Mathilde
description: NEAR Shoemaker flies within 1,212 kilometers of C-type asteroid 253 Mathilde, revealing huge impact craters and low bulk density.

title: Mars Global Surveyor Reaches Mars and Commences Months-Long Aerobraking Campaign
description: NASA's Mars Global Surveyor spacecraft enters Martian orbit and uses atmospheric drag to circularize its orbit for global mapping.

title: Lunar Prospector Launched to Map Moon Surface Composition and Detect Polar Ice
description: NASA's Lunar Prospector orbiter launches from Cape Canaveral to conduct low-altitude orbital geochemical mapping of the Moon.

title: NEAR Shoemaker Becomes First Spacecraft to Insert into Orbit Around an Asteroid
description: NEAR Shoemaker successfully maneuvers into orbit around near-Earth asteroid 433 Eros on Valentine's Day.

title: Haile Gebrselassie Edges Paul Tergat by Nine Hundredths in Epic Sydney 10000m Final
description: Haile Gebrselassie out-dips Kenya's Paul Tergat by 0.09 seconds after a ferocious home-straight sprint in the greatest 10000m Olympic final.

title: Thibaut Pinot Conquers Col du Tourmalet with Roaring French Mountain Victory
description: Thibaut Pinot surges past Julian Alaphilippe and Geraint Thomas on the steep final kilometer to win stage 14 atop the Col du Tourmalet.

title: Namita Gokhale Awarded Sahitya Akademi Award for English Novel Things to Leave Behind
description: Namita Gokhale was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award for her Kumaon historical chronicle.

title: Jonas Vingegaard Drops Tadej Pogacar on Col du Granon to Seize Tour Control
description: Jonas Vingegaard and Jumbo-Visma execute a coordinated mountain ambush on the Col du Granon, taking nearly three minutes out of Pogacar.

title: Tom Pidcock Descends Masterfully and Solos to Bastille Day Victory on Alpe d'Huez
description: Twenty-two-year-old Tom Pidcock showcases breathtaking descending off the Galibier and climbs solo up Alpe d'Huez to win stage 12.

title: Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi Formally Dedicates Silent Valley National Park in Kerala
description: Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi inaugurated Silent Valley National Park following the historic Save Silent Valley movement.

title: India First Scientifically Documented Test-Tube Baby Harsha Born in Mumbai
description: Dr. Indira Hinduja and team delivered Harsha Chawda via in-vitro fertilisation at KEM Hospital in Mumbai.

title: Government of Himachal Pradesh Establishes Pin Valley National Park in Spiti
description: The cold desert biosphere sanctuary of Pin Valley was notified to conserve endangered Tibetan gazelles and snow leopards.

title: Kudremukh National Park Formally Notified Along Western Ghats in Karnataka
description: The tropical evergreen shola grassland habitat of Kudremukh in Chikkamagaluru was declared a National Park.

title: Surgeon Dr. P. Venugopal Performs India First Successful Heart Transplant at AIIMS
description: A 20-member surgical team at AIIMS New Delhi performed India's first successful heart transplant on Devi Ram.

title: Computer Scientist Antony Hoare Named Kyoto Prize Laureate in Advanced Technology
description: Sir Antony Hoare is awarded the Kyoto Prize for developing the Quicksort algorithm and Hoare logic for program verification.

title: Mars Odyssey Spacecraft Successfully Fires Orbit Insertion Engine at Mars
description: 2001 Mars Odyssey enters orbit around Mars to search for evidence of past water and map elemental surface mineralogy.

title: Stardust Spacecraft Flies Through Coma of Comet Wild Two Collecting Dust Grains
description: NASA's Stardust probe flies within 237 kilometers of Comet Wild 2, deploying aerogel collectors to trap pristine cometary particles.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Geoffrey Marcy and Michel Mayor for Exoplanets
description: Michel Mayor and Geoffrey Marcy receive the Shaw Prize in Astronomy for discovering the first extrasolar planets orbiting Sun-like stars.

title: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter MRO Fires Main Engines to Enter Martian Orbit
description: NASA's MRO enters Mars orbit carrying the ultra-high-resolution HiRISE camera to begin capturing detailed surface features.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Perlmutter Riess and Schmidt for Accelerating Universe
description: Saul Perlmutter, Adam Riess, and Brian Schmidt receive the Shaw Prize for discovering the accelerating expansion of the universe via Type Ia supernovae.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Peter Goldreich for Theoretical Astrophysics
description: Peter Goldreich receives the Shaw Prize in Astronomy for seminal theories of planetary ring dynamics, spiral density waves, and astrophysical masers.

title: Geophysicist Hiroo Kanamori Named Kyoto Prize Laureate in Basic Sciences
description: Hiroo Kanamori receives the Kyoto Prize for developing the moment magnitude scale and elucidating physics of giant subduction earthquakes.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Reinhard Genzel for Galactic Center Supermassive Black Hole
description: Reinhard Genzel is awarded the Shaw Prize in Astronomy for proving the existence of a supermassive black hole at Sagittarius A*.

title: Hayabusa Capsule Lands at Woomera Australia Carrying First Samples from an Asteroid
description: JAXA's Hayabusa sample capsule streaks across the Australian night sky to land safely at Woomera with microscopic particles of Itokawa.

title: Chang'e Three and Yutu Jade Rabbit Rover Achieve Soft Landing on the Moon
description: China's Chang'e 3 touches down in Mare Imbrium, deploying the Yutu rover in the first lunar soft landing since Soviet Luna 24 in 1976.

title: MESSENGER Concludes Mercury Orbital Mission with High-Speed Surface Impact
description: Having exhausted its propellant, MESSENGER crashes onto Mercury's surface at 14,000 km/h, creating a new crater after four years in orbit.

title: Rosetta Spacecraft Concludes Mission with Controlled Descent onto Comet 67P Surface
description: Rosetta transmits high-resolution images and gas measurements down to the final meters before impacting Comet 67P's Ma'at region.

title: OSIRIS-REx Arrives at Diamond-Shaped Carbonaceous Asteroid Bennu
description: NASA's OSIRIS-REx matches speed and begins proximity operations around near-Earth asteroid 101955 Bennu to survey sample sites.

title: Hayabusa Two Capsule Touches Down in Woomera Delivering Subsurface Samples from Asteroid Ryugu
description: JAXA's Hayabusa2 capsule returns 5.4 grams of carbonaceous material and primordial gases collected from asteroid Ryugu.

title: Government of Uttar Pradesh Notifies Dudhwa National Park in Terai Region
description: Conservationist Billy Arjan Singh's efforts led to the declaration of Dudhwa National Park along the Indo-Nepal border.

title: Kerala Government Establishes Eravikulam National Park to Protect Nilgiri Tahr
description: The high-altitude shola-grassland ecosystem of Eravikulam in the Western Ghats was notified as a National Park.

title: Maharashtra Government Notifies Sanjay Gandhi National Park at Borivali
description: The protected urban forest tract inside Mumbai suburban limits was formally designated a National Park.

title: Bihar Government Establishes Valmiki National Park in West Champaran
description: The sal forests of Valmiki on the Royal Chitwan border were declared a National Park and Tiger Reserve.

title: Doctors Perform India First Successful Pediatric Liver Transplant in New Delhi
description: Surgeons at Apollo Hospital New Delhi performed India's first successful liver transplant on toddler Sanjay Kandasamy.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Frank Shu for Star Formation Mechanisms
description: Frank Shu receives the Shaw Prize in Astronomy for developing the self-similar collapse model of molecular cloud cores forming protostars.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on WMAP Leadership Team for Precision Cosmology
description: Charles Bennett, Lyman Page, and David Spergel receive the Shaw Prize for determining cosmic age and geometry with WMAP.

title: Kavli Prize in Astrophysics Conferred on Jerry Nelson Ray Wilson and James Angel
description: Jerry Nelson, Ray Wilson, and James Angel receive the Kavli Prize for segmented mirrors and active optics transforming giant telescopes.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Enrico Costa and Gerald Fishman for Gamma-Ray Bursts
description: Enrico Costa and Gerald Fishman receive the Shaw Prize in Astronomy for discovering that gamma-ray bursts originate at cosmological distances.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on David Jewitt and Jane Luu for Kuiper Belt Objects
description: David Jewitt and Jane Luu receive the Shaw Prize in Astronomy for discovering trans-Neptunian bodies populating the Kuiper Belt.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Steven Balbus and John Hawley for Magnetorotational Instability
description: Steven Balbus and John Hawley receive the Shaw Prize for discovering magnetorotational instability driving accretion disks in astrophysics.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on William Borucki for Kepler Exoplanet Mission
description: William Borucki receives the Shaw Prize in Astronomy for conceiving and leading the Kepler Space Telescope mission discovering thousands of exoplanets.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Drever Thorne and Weiss for Gravitational Waves
description: Ronald Drever, Kip Thorne, and Rainer Weiss receive the Shaw Prize for conceiving and designing LIGO to detect gravitational waves.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Simon White for Structure Formation in Universe
description: Simon White receives the Shaw Prize in Astronomy for N-body numerical simulations establishing cold dark matter galaxy formation.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Jean-Loup Puget for Cosmic Far-Infrared Background
description: Jean-Loup Puget receives the Shaw Prize in Astronomy for detecting the cosmic far-infrared background radiation from early dust-obscured galaxies.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Edward Stone for Voyager Interstellar Mission
description: Edward Stone receives the Shaw Prize in Astronomy for 47 years of leadership on the Voyager mission crossing into interstellar space.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Roger Blandford for Relativistic Astrophysical Jets
description: Roger Blandford receives the Shaw Prize in Astronomy for formulating the Blandford-Znajek mechanism extracting energy from spinning black holes.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Victoria Kaspi and Chryssa Kouveliotou for Magnetars
description: Victoria Kaspi and Chryssa Kouveliotou receive the Shaw Prize for elucidating magnetars as highly magnetized neutron stars.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Lennart Lindegren and Michael Perryman for Gaia Astrometry
description: Lennart Lindegren and Michael Perryman receive the Shaw Prize for conceiving space astrometry missions Hipparcos and Gaia.

title: Shaw Prize in Astronomy Conferred on Bailes Lorimer and McLaughlin for Fast Radio Bursts
description: Matthew Bailes, Duncan Lorimer, and Maura McLaughlin receive the Shaw Prize for discovering fast radio bursts (FRBs).

title: Philip Johnson Bestowed Inaugural Pritzker Architecture Prize at Dumbarton Oaks
description: Philip Johnson receives the inaugural Pritzker Architecture Prize for 50 years of design leadership including the Glass House.

title: British Architect James Stirling Receives Pritzker Architecture Prize in Washington
description: James Stirling receives the Pritzker Prize at the National Building Museum for post-modern masterworks like the Staatsgalerie Stuttgart.

title: Austrian Architect Hans Hollein Receives Pritzker Architecture Prize at Huntington Library
description: Hans Hollein is awarded the Pritzker Prize in San Marino, California, for witty eclectic design spanning museums and Viennese interiors.

title: Gottfried Bohm Receives Pritzker Architecture Prize at Goldsmiths Hall in London
description: German architect Gottfried Bohm receives the Pritzker Prize for sculptural monolithic concrete churches including Neviges Pilgrimage Church.

title: Jharkhand Government Notifies Betla National Park in Chota Nagpur Plateau
description: Betla National Park in Latehar district was officially declared, hosting one of India's earliest tiger sanctuaries.

title: Assam Government Upgrades Nameri Wildlife Sanctuary to National Park
description: The biodiverse foothills reserve of Nameri in Sonitpur district was formally notified as a National Park.

title: Assam Government Formally Notifies Dibru-Saikhowa National Park
description: The wet evergreen riverine forest and feral horse sanctuary was formally designated a National Park.

title: Maharashtra Government Establishes Chandoli National Park in Sahyadri Range
description: Chandoli National Park was officially notified, forming the southern part of the Sahyadri Tiger Reserve.

title: Assam Government Formally Upgrades Kaziranga to Tiger Reserve
description: Kaziranga National Park was declared a Tiger Reserve under Project Tiger, hosting the world's highest density of tigers.

title: Kavli Prize in Nanoscience Conferred on Donald Eigler and Nadrian Seeman
description: Donald Eigler and Nadrian Seeman receive the Kavli Prize for atomic manipulation with STM tips and structural DNA nanotechnology.

title: Kavli Prize in Astrophysics Conferred on David Jewitt Jane Luu and Michael Brown
description: David Jewitt, Jane Luu, and Michael Brown receive the Kavli Prize for discovering Kuiper Belt objects and reshaping the outer Solar System.

title: Kavli Prize in Nanoscience Conferred on Mildred Dresselhaus for Carbon Nanostructures
description: Mildred Dresselhaus receives the Kavli Prize in Nanoscience for pioneering electronic band structure analysis of carbon nanotubes and graphene.

title: Kavli Prize in Astrophysics Conferred on Alan Guth Andrei Linde and Alexei Starobinsky
description: Alan Guth, Andrei Linde, and Alexei Starobinsky receive the Kavli Prize for pioneering the theory of cosmic inflation.

title: Kavli Prize in Nanoscience Conferred on Thomas Ebbesen Stefan Hell and John Pendry
description: Thomas Ebbesen, Stefan Hell, and John Pendry receive the Kavli Prize for nanoscale optics beyond the Abbe diffraction limit.

title: Kavli Prize in Astrophysics Conferred on Ewine van Dishoeck for Astrochemistry
description: Ewine van Dishoeck receives the Kavli Prize in Astrophysics for observational and theoretical breakthroughs in interstellar molecular chemistry.

title: Kavli Prize in Nanoscience Conferred on Paul Alivisatos Sumio Iijima and Louis Brus
description: Paul Alivisatos, Sumio Iijima, and Louis Brus receive the Kavli Prize for discovering semiconductor quantum dots and carbon nanotubes.

title: Kavli Prize in Astrophysics Conferred on Andrew Fabian for X-Ray Astronomy of Galaxy Clusters
description: Andrew Fabian receives the Kavli Prize in Astrophysics for multi-wavelength studies of AGN feedback heating intergalactic gas in galaxy clusters.

title: Kavli Prize in Nanoscience Conferred on Harald Rose Maximilian Haider and Knut Urban
description: Harald Rose, Maximilian Haider, Knut Urban, and Ondrej Krivanek receive the Kavli Prize for sub-angstrom aberration-corrected electron microscopy.

title: Kavli Prize in Astrophysics Conferred on Conny Aerts Jorgen Christensen-Dalsgaard and Kurtz
description: Conny Aerts, Jorgen Christensen-Dalsgaard, and Donald Kurtz receive the Kavli Prize for asteroseismology mapping stellar interior structures.

title: Kavli Prize in Nanoscience Conferred on David Allardice David Basov and Ralph Nuzzo
description: David Allardice, Jacob Sagiv, Ralph Nuzzo, and David Allara receive the Kavli Prize for self-assembled monolayers on solid surfaces.

title: Royal Society Awards Copley Medal to Francis Crick for Structure of DNA
description: Francis Crick is awarded the Copley Medal of the Royal Society for elucidating the structure of DNA and continuing work on the genetic code.

title: Royal Society Awards Copley Medal to Dorothy Hodgkin for Structural Crystallography
description: Dorothy Hodgkin receives the Copley Medal for solving structures of penicillin, vitamin B12, and insulin via X-ray crystallography.

title: Kenzo Tange Becomes First Japanese Architect to Receive Pritzker Architecture Prize
description: Kenzo Tange receives the Pritzker Prize at the Kimbell Art Museum for the Yoyogi National Gymnasium and Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park.

title: Italian Architect Aldo Rossi Receives Pritzker Architecture Prize at Palazzo Grassi in Venice
description: Aldo Rossi is awarded the Pritzker Prize for neo-rationalist urban theory and timeless geometric monumental forms.

title: Robert Venturi Receives Pritzker Architecture Prize at Palacio de Iturbide in Mexico City
description: Robert Venturi receives the Pritzker Prize for championing complexity and contradiction against orthodox minimalist modernism.

title: Fumihiko Maki Receives Pritzker Architecture Prize at Historic Prague Castle
description: Metabolist pioneer Fumihiko Maki receives the Pritzker Architecture Prize in the Czech Republic for light-filled collective form.

title: Renzo Piano Receives Pritzker Architecture Prize on South Lawn of the White House
description: Renzo Piano receives the Pritzker Architecture Prize in Washington DC for the Centre Pompidou, Menil Collection, and Kansai Airport.

title: Fields Medals Conferred on Okounkov Tao and Werner at Madrid ICM While Perelman Declines
description: Andrei Okounkov, Terence Tao, and Wendelin Werner receive Fields Medals in Madrid, while Russian mathematician Grigori Perelman famously declines.

title: Fields Medals Conferred on Lindenstrauss Ngo Smirnov and Cedric Villani at Hyderabad ICM
description: Elon Lindenstrauss, Ngo Bao Chau, Stanislav Smirnov, and Cedric Villani receive Fields Medals at the International Congress in Hyderabad.

title: Maryam Mirzakhani Becomes First Woman to Win Fields Medal at Seoul ICM
description: Iranian-born mathematician Maryam Mirzakhani makes history receiving the Fields Medal alongside Artur Avila, Manjul Bhargava, and Martin Hairer in Seoul.

title: Anti-Submarine Warfare Corvette INS Kamorta Commissioned at Visakhapatnam
description: The Indian Navy commissions INS Kamorta, the first of four indigenous Kamorta-class anti-submarine corvettes built by GRSE.

title: Frei Otto Posthumously Bestowed Pritzker Architecture Prize at New World Center in Miami
description: German structural engineer Frei Otto is honored posthumously for pioneering lightweight tensile membrane roofs at the 1972 Munich Olympic Stadium.

title: Anti-Submarine Stealth Corvette INS Kadmatt Commissioned into Eastern Naval Command
description: The Indian Navy commissions INS Kadmatt, the second indigenous anti-submarine warfare corvette of Project 28.

title: Anti-Submarine Warfare Corvette INS Kiltan Commissioned at Naval Dockyard Visakhapatnam
description: Defense Minister Nirmala Sitharaman commissions INS Kiltan, featuring an advanced composite superstructure.

title: Scorpene-Class Submarine INS Kalvari Commissioned into Indian Navy by Prime Minister Modi
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi commissions INS Kalvari, the first indigenous Kalvari-class diesel-electric attack submarine.

title: Fields Medals Conferred on Birkar Figalli Peter Scholze and Venkatesh at Rio ICM
description: Caucher Birkar, Alessio Figalli, Peter Scholze, and Akshay Venkatesh receive Fields Medals at the Rio de Janeiro International Congress.

title: Anti-Submarine Stealth Corvette INS Kavaratti Commissioned at Visakhapatnam
description: Indian Army Chief General MM Naravane commissions the indigenous anti-submarine warfare corvette INS Kavaratti.

title: Burkinabe Architect Francis Kere Announced as First African Pritzker Prize Laureate
description: Francis Kere is named the 2022 Pritzker Architecture Prize laureate for clay and timber schools built collaboratively with local communities.

title: Ukrainian Mathematician Maryna Viazovska Receives Fields Medal for Sphere Packing
description: Maryna Viazovska receives the Fields Medal in Helsinki for her breakthrough proof of optimal 8-dimensional and 24-dimensional sphere packings.

title: British Architect David Chipperfield Announced as 2023 Pritzker Architecture Prize Laureate
description: Sir David Chipperfield is named the 2023 Pritzker Prize laureate for subtle, understated historic restorations including the Neues Museum Berlin.

title: Niki Lauda Dominates Monaco Grand Prix to Secure First Ferrari Win in Principality in Twenty Years
description: Niki Lauda leads from pole in damp-to-dry conditions to win the 33rd Monaco Grand Prix for Scuderia Ferrari.

title: Niki Lauda Dominates Monaco Grand Prix from Pole for Second Consecutive Year
description: Reigning world champion Niki Lauda drives unchallenged through the streets of Monte Carlo to claim his fourth win of 1976.

title: Jody Scheckter Delivers Maiden Monaco Grand Prix Victory for Wolf Racing
description: South African Jody Scheckter takes the lead at the start and holds off Niki Lauda to win the Monaco GP for the debutant Wolf team.

title: Patrick Depailler Captures Maiden Formula One Victory at Monaco Grand Prix
description: French driver Patrick Depailler takes his first career Formula 1 victory driving the Tyrrell 008 through the streets of Monaco.

title: Jody Scheckter Leads Ferrari One-Two Victory at Monaco Grand Prix
description: Jody Scheckter holds off a furious late charge from Didier Pironi and Patrick Depailler to win the Monaco Grand Prix for Ferrari.

title: Carlos Reutemann Splashes to Victory in Rain-Soaked Monaco Grand Prix for Williams
description: Argentina's Carlos Reutemann survives treacherous wet streets and Derek Daly's airborne start crash to win at Monaco.

title: Gilles Villeneuve Tames Turbocharged Ferrari to Win Epic Monaco Grand Prix
description: Gilles Villeneuve wrestles his ill-handling Ferrari 126CK turbo around the tight Armco barriers to overtake Alan Jones and win.

title: Riccardo Patrese Wins Chaotic Monaco Grand Prix After Five Leaders Suffer Late Disaster
description: Riccardo Patrese bump-starts his Brabham after spinning in late rain, unaware he has won the craziest race in Monaco history.

title: Keke Rosberg Masters Damp Streets on Slick Tires to Win Monaco Grand Prix
description: Reigning champion Keke Rosberg gambles on dry slick tires on a wet track, opening an insurmountable 38-second lead in his Williams.

title: Alain Prost Wins Red-Flagged Monaco Grand Prix as Rookie Ayrton Senna Stuns in Rain
description: In torrential rain, Alain Prost waves for the race to be stopped as Toleman rookie Ayrton Senna slashes his lead by three seconds per lap.

title: Alain Prost Controls Monaco Grand Prix from Pole for McLaren-TAG
description: Alain Prost inherits the lead when Michele Alboreto punctures on Nelson Piquet's blown engine oil, cruising to victory in Monte Carlo.

title: Alain Prost Dominates Monaco Grand Prix to Complete Hat-Trick of Principality Wins
description: Alain Prost leads from lights to flag in his McLaren-TAG, becoming the first driver since Graham Hill to win three consecutive Monaco GPs.

title: Ayrton Senna Captures First Career Monaco Grand Prix Victory in Active-Suspension Lotus
description: Ayrton Senna claims the first of his record six Monaco victories, driving the yellow Lotus 99T equipped with computerized active suspension.

title: Alain Prost Inherits Monaco Victory as Ayrton Senna Crashes While Leading by Fifty Seconds
description: Ayrton Senna loses concentration on lap 67 and clouts the barrier at Portier, handing an astonished Alain Prost the Monaco Grand Prix win.

title: Ayrton Senna Cruises to Fifty-Two-Second Monaco Grand Prix Victory Over Alain Prost
description: Despite losing first and second gears on his McLaren-Honda, Ayrton Senna dominates the 1989 Monaco Grand Prix ahead of teammate Prost.

title: First Indigenous Stealth Frigate INS Shivalik Commissioned into Indian Navy
description: Defence Minister A.K. Antony commissioned INS Shivalik, India's first indigenously designed stealth guided-missile frigate, at Mumbai.

title: Stealth Frigate INS Satpura Formally Commissioned into Eastern Fleet at Visakhapatnam
description: The Indian Navy commissioned INS Satpura, the second Shivalik-class multi-role stealth frigate, at the naval dockyard in Mumbai.

title: Attack Submarine INS Khanderi Formally Commissioned into Indian Navy Fleet at Mumbai
description: Defense Minister Rajnath Singh commissions INS Khanderi, the second Kalvari-class attack submarine, at Naval Dockyard Mumbai.

title: Diesel-Electric Attack Submarine INS Karanj Commissioned at Mumbai Naval Dockyard
description: The Indian Navy commissions INS Karanj, the third Scorpene-class attack submarine built under Project 75 at Mazagon Dock.

title: Kalvari-Class Attack Submarine INS Vela Commissioned into Indian Navy Western Fleet
description: INS Vela, the fourth Scorpene-class stealth attack submarine, is commissioned into the Indian Navy at Mumbai.

title: Ayrton Senna Converts Pole Position into Commanding Monaco Grand Prix Triumph
description: Ayrton Senna leads every lap of the 1990 Monaco Grand Prix to take his third victory in the Principality ahead of Jean Alesi.

title: Ayrton Senna Wins Fourth Monaco Grand Prix with Flawless Lights-to-Flag Display
description: Ayrton Senna takes his fourth consecutive win of the 1991 season, managing tire wear perfectly on the Monte Carlo street circuit.

title: Ayrton Senna Holds Off Nigel Mansell in Breathless Three-Lap Duel to Win Monaco
description: Ayrton Senna places his McLaren wide at every corner to hold off Nigel Mansell's charging Williams-Renault by two-tenths of a second.

title: First Train on Konkan Railway Network Runs Between Mangalore and Udupi
description: Commercial passenger rail operations begin on the newly laid Konkan Railway section between Mangalore and Udupi.

title: Ayrton Senna Captures Record Sixth Monaco Grand Prix Victory in McLaren
description: Ayrton Senna surpasses Graham Hill's legendary record by winning his sixth Monaco Grand Prix, driving a Ford-powered McLaren MP4/8.

title: Michael Schumacher Dominates Somber Monaco Grand Prix for Benetton
description: Michael Schumacher scores his first Monaco victory by 37 seconds over Martin Brundle in the first race following Ayrton Senna's fatal crash.

title: Michael Schumacher Executes Clinical Two-Stop Strategy to Win Monaco Grand Prix
description: Michael Schumacher leaps ahead of Damon Hill during pit stops to win his second Monaco Grand Prix for Benetton-Renault.

title: Olivier Panis Stuns Formula One Winning Chaotic Wet Monaco GP from Fourteenth on Grid
description: Frenchman Olivier Panis survives relentless rain and mechanical carnage as only three cars cross the finish line, handing Ligier its final win.

title: Michael Schumacher Demolishes Field in Torrential Rain to Win Monaco Grand Prix for Ferrari
description: Michael Schumacher builds a six-second lead on the opening lap of a soaked Monaco GP, finishing 53 seconds clear of Rubens Barrichello.

title: Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee Formally Dedicates Entire Konkan Railway Route to Nation
description: Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee dedicates the complete 760-kilometer Konkan Railway route spanning Maharashtra, Goa, and Karnataka.

title: Mika Hakkinen Delivers Lights-to-Flag Masterclass to Win Monaco Grand Prix for McLaren
description: Mika Hakkinen converts pole position into a dominant victory through the streets of Monte Carlo, holding off Giancarlo Fisichella.

title: Michael Schumacher Leads Ferrari One-Two Finish at 1999 Monaco Grand Prix
description: Michael Schumacher captures his fourth Monaco victory, leading teammate Eddie Irvine across the line for Ferrari's first Monaco 1-2 since 1979.

title: David Coulthard Inherits Monaco Grand Prix Victory After Schumacher Exhaust Fails
description: David Coulthard takes victory for McLaren after Michael Schumacher's broken exhaust cooks his rear suspension while holding a 36-second lead.

title: Michael Schumacher Wins Fifth Monaco Grand Prix Leading Ferrari One-Two with Barrichello
description: Michael Schumacher ties Graham Hill with five Monaco victories as pole-sitter David Coulthard stalls on the formation lap.

title: Prime Minister Vajpayee Flags Off First Jan Shatabdi Express Between Mumbai and Madgaon
description: Indian Railways launches the affordable Jan Shatabdi service connecting Lokmanya Tilak Terminus to Madgaon on the 149th railway anniversary.

title: David Coulthard Resists Relentless Michael Schumacher Pressure to Win Monaco Grand Prix
description: David Coulthard takes the lead at the start and fends off Michael Schumacher's smoke-trailing Ferrari to claim his second Monaco GP win.

title: Juan Pablo Montoya Breaks Williams Twenty-Year Monaco Drought with Precision Drive
description: Colombia's Juan Pablo Montoya edges Kimi Raikkonen and Michael Schumacher in a nose-to-tail sprint to win for Williams-BMW.

title: Jarno Trulli Converts Maiden Pole into Historic Maiden Grand Prix Victory at Monaco
description: Jarno Trulli drives a flawless race for Renault to hold off Jenson Button by four-tenths of a second for his solitary Formula 1 triumph.

title: Stealth Frigate INS Sahyadri Commissioned into Western Naval Command at Mumbai
description: Defence Minister A.K. Antony commissioned INS Sahyadri, completing the trio of Project 17 indigenously built stealth frigates.

title: PSLV-C36 Successfully Launches Resourcesat-2A Remote Sensing Satellite
description: ISRO launches Resourcesat-2A into sun-synchronous orbit using camera-mounted vehicle monitoring systems.

title: Keoladeo National Park in Bharatpur Inscribed on UNESCO World Heritage List
description: UNESCO confers World Heritage status on Keoladeo Ghana bird sanctuary in Rajasthan for hosting thousands of migratory waterfowl.

title: Nanda Devi National Park in Uttarakhand Inscribed as UNESCO World Heritage Site
description: UNESCO inscribes Nanda Devi National Park in the Garhwal Himalayas for exceptional wilderness surrounding India's second highest peak.

title: Kimi Raikkonen Drives Masterful Lights-to-Flag Race to Win Monaco Grand Prix for McLaren
description: Kimi Raikkonen builds a 30-second lead before a safety car and manages degrading rear tires to win his first Monaco Grand Prix.

title: Fernando Alonso Captures Maiden Monaco Grand Prix Victory for Renault
description: Fernando Alonso absorbs relentless pressure from Kimi Raikkonen until the McLaren engine fails, cruising to his first Monaco victory.

title: Railway Minister Lalu Prasad Yadav Flags Off First Garib Rath Express from Saharsa to Amritsar
description: Indian Railways introduces the no-frills air-conditioned Garib Rath Express offering subsidized three-tier AC travel.

title: Fernando Alonso Leads Dominant McLaren One-Two Finish at 2007 Monaco Grand Prix
description: Fernando Alonso leads rookie teammate Lewis Hamilton home by four seconds as McLaren laps the entire field up to third place.

title: Lewis Hamilton Survives Early Barrier Tap and Puncture to Win Wet Monaco Grand Prix
description: Lewis Hamilton clips the Tabac barrier on lap six, pits for a tire and fuel change, and stormingly rallies to his maiden Monaco win.

title: Jenson Button Sprints Down Pit Straight After Leading Brawn GP One-Two at Monaco
description: Jenson Button parks his Brawn BGP 001 in the wrong parc ferme and famously jogs 400 meters down the pit straight to the royal podium.

title: Mark Webber Leads Every Lap from Pole to Secure Red Bull Racing Maiden Monaco Triumph
description: Mark Webber withstands four safety car restarts to lead Sebastian Vettel home in a commanding Red Bull 1-2 through Monte Carlo.

title: Sebastian Vettel Gambles on Single-Stop Strategy to Win Thrilling Monaco Grand Prix
description: Sebastian Vettel runs 56 laps on soft tires, saved by a late red flag that allows a free tire change to edge Alonso and Button.

title: Nico Rosberg Emulates Father Keke Thirty Years Later to Win Monaco Grand Prix for Mercedes
description: Nico Rosberg controls two safety cars and a red flag to win from pole position for Mercedes, thirty years after his father's 1983 triumph.

title: Prime Minister Manmohan Singh Inaugurates Eleven-Kilometer Pir Panjal Railway Tunnel in Kashmir
description: Prime Minister Manmohan Singh opens India's longest transportation railway tunnel through the Pir Panjal mountain range.

title: Nico Rosberg Withstands Lewis Hamilton Pressure to Win Consecutive Monaco Grand Prix
description: Nico Rosberg leads from pole to flag ahead of Lewis Hamilton, taking the championship lead in a tense intra-team Mercedes battle.

title: Nico Rosberg Inherits Hat-Trick Monaco Victory After Mercedes Miscalculates Hamilton Pit Stop
description: Nico Rosberg joins Senna, Prost, and Graham Hill with three straight Monaco wins when Mercedes pits Hamilton under a late safety car.

title: Lewis Hamilton Stretches Wet Tires to Dry Track to Stun Daniel Ricciardo at Monaco
description: Lewis Hamilton stays out on extreme wets until the track dries, taking the lead when Red Bull botches Ricciardo's tire stop in the pits.

title: Sebastian Vettel Overcuts Kimi Raikkonen to Lead Ferrari One-Two at 2017 Monaco GP
description: Sebastian Vettel unleashes fast laps before his pit stop to overcut teammate Raikkonen and secure Ferrari's first Monaco win in 16 years.

title: Daniel Ricciardo Nurses Severely Crippled Red Bull to Emotional Monaco Grand Prix Redemption
description: Daniel Ricciardo loses 160 horsepower and two gears when his MGU-K fails on lap 28, brilliantly defending against Vettel to win.

title: Prime Minister Modi Flags Off Second Vande Bharat Express Between New Delhi and Katra
description: Home Minister Amit Shah and Railway Minister Piyush Goyal flag off the commercial Vande Bharat Express to Vaishno Devi Katra.

title: Max Verstappen Commands Monaco Grand Prix from Front to Seize World Championship Lead
description: Max Verstappen controls the race after pole-sitter Charles Leclerc fails to start, winning by eight seconds over Carlos Sainz.

title: Delhi Defeats Karnataka to Win Maiden Ranji Trophy Title

title: Clay Regazzoni Delivers Historic First Grand Prix Victory for Williams at Silverstone
description: Clay Regazzoni captures Frank Williams's maiden Formula 1 victory driving the Williams FW07 in the 1979 British Grand Prix.

title: Delhi Defeats Bombay to Win Second Ranji Trophy Title in Delhi
description: Delhi defeats powerhouse Bombay by an innings and 145 runs at Feroz Shah Kotla to retain the Ranji Trophy.

title: Bombay Defeats Delhi to Win Ranji Trophy at Wankhede Stadium
description: Bombay defeats Delhi by an innings and 46 runs at Wankhede Stadium to win the 47th Ranji Trophy.

title: John Watson Drives Carbon-Composite McLaren MP4-1 to Landmark British GP Victory
description: Northern Ireland's John Watson wins the British Grand Prix, proving the revolutionary carbon-fibre composite chassis designed by John Barnard.

title: Nigel Mansell Executes Iconic Dummy Overtake on Nelson Piquet at Stowe to Win British GP
description: Nigel Mansell breaks the lap record eleven times in 30 laps, selling Piquet a high-speed dummy at 170 mph to win at Silverstone.

title: Ayrton Senna Delivers Wet-Weather Masterclass to Win Rain-Lashed 1988 British Grand Prix
description: Ayrton Senna dominates treacherous wet conditions at Silverstone, lapping the entire field up to third place in his McLaren-Honda.

title: Nigel Mansell Gives Ayrton Senna Sidepod Taxi Ride After Winning 1991 British Grand Prix
